description: Completed games with results for a single team: `homeScore`/`awayScore` plus `teamScore`/`opponentScore`/`result` from this school's point of view. Each side's score is stored independently upstream, so a half-entered game yields a null score and `result: null` — a missing score is unknown, never zero. Prefer mpaz_get_team_schedule for upcoming fixtures. Each event's `startLocal` is the local time at the school (in `timeZone`, e.g. America/New_York) — quote it as-is; `start` is the same moment in true UTC. Read-only.

sportSlug.description: Sport slug, "<gender>-<sport>", e.g. boys-football, girls-volleyball. From mpaz_list_teams.

teamId.description: Numeric team id from mpaz_list_teams / mpaz_resolve_team. Ids differ per school year.

year.description: School year, e.g. "2026-2027". Defaults to the current one. Past seasons often work; resolve that year's team id with mpaz_list_teams first and read its `coverage` note.

name: mpaz_get_scores
title: Get one team's results
